Summary: Courage is the strength to do what is right when fear says otherwise, and Scripture ties it to God's presence rather than to personality. Joshua was told to be strong and courageous because God would be with him, and Esther risked her life with the words, if I perish, I perish. Christian courage is not the absence of fear but obedience in spite of it.
